reasoning: E6 records a link from en-unreturned-island (d1) to en-bond-maintenance (d2) whose function is that d1 tests bond-keeping practices, and E2 states the disappearance tests whether the practices can adapt, producing the three action families. E2 also states the practices as standing community action, and E4 has the author describe them as long-learned, so the practices do not depend on d1 while their test does. Labelling this 'enables' is an inference: the record says 'tests', so d1 enables the test and the action families it produces, not d2 as a whole.
quote: The disappearance tests whether those practices can adapt, producing repeated action families of reaching out, keeping faith and repairing.
alternative_reading: Narrowly, the record establishes that d1 tests d2's practices and that this test produces the action families. 'Enables' reads correctly only as 'enables the test and its action families'. It does not mean d1 enables the bond-keeping practices themselves, which E2 and E4 present as existing independently.
creative_room: The author may develop the bonds independently of the disappearance, for example by establishing them first, and stage the test later. How the practices adapt, fail or transform under the test is open. The cited items do not state which of the three action families dominates, or when.
